descriptionFull: The common linnet ( Linaria cannabina ) is a small passerine bird of the finch family, Fringillidae. It derives its common name and the scientific name, Linaria , from its fondness for hemp seeds and flax seeds—flax being the English name of the plant from which linen is made.
